title: A Closer Look at the Existing Risks of Generative AI: Mapping the Who, What, and How of Real-World Incidents

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic manual coding and frequency analysis of 499 publicly reported Generative AI incidents (sourced from the AIID and AIAAIC databases) to identify and count real-world occurrences of stereotyping, toxic content, and failures stemming from poor quality training data that exacerbates societal biases.
